segments: One stone. The prediction of the Temple's destruction was literally fulfilled.  The whole building was laid even with the ground.

entries.title: Matthew 24:5
segments: Shall come in my name. Among such pretenders who appeared before the destruction of Jerusalem were Simon Magus, Dositheus and Menander.

entries.title: Matthew 24:16
segments: Flee unto the mountains. Many Christians fled to Pella in Perea during the siege of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Matthew 24:22
segments: Those days. The days of the siege, whose horrors were so great that only their being shortened allowed any to escape.  Jerusalem was captured by the Romans on August 10, A.D. 70.

entries.title: Matthew 24:26
segments: In the wilderness. A false Christ or prophet might strive to lure people after him by an ascetic life.

entries.title: Matthew 24:29
segments: The sun shall be darkened, etc.  The striking and figurative expressions contained in
are characteristic of scripture prophecy, especially in the Old Testament.

entries.title: Matthew 24:32
segments: From the fig tree. This parable has been interpreted to mean the coming of the kingdom of heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 24:37
segments: As were the days of Noah. See

entries.title: Matthew 24:41
segments: Two women shall be grinding. The custom of women grinding grain with handmills is alluded to.  In Palestine these mills are still in common use where there are no mill streams.

entries.title: Matthew 24:42
segments: Watch therefore: for ye know not on what day. An argument as well as a command.  The uncertainty of the Lord's coming will not permit any lack of vigilance.

entries.title: Matthew 24:43
segments: If the master of the house had known. The bitter reflection of all who neglect their duty and lament the resulting loss and punishment.  This truth is brought home by three parables: the wise servant, the ten virgins and the talents.

entries.title: Matthew 24:45
segments: Whom his lord hath set over his household. This was a servant who was promoted to be a steward, a reward of fidelity and discretion.  The position called for the ability of a manager and the honesty of a faithful trustee.

entries.title: Matthew 24:47
segments: Over all that he hath. Still further promotion; he now has charge of all his lord's affairs.

entries.title: Matthew 24:48
segments: Shall say in his heart. In the promptings of a heart that is unfaithful begins the failure of watchfulness.  The evil servant thought he could speculate on the time of his lord's return.  He was in danger from the moment when he said, My Lord tarrieth.
